statement: The pinned WiiBrew Wiimote Data Reporting section documents mode 0x30 (core buttons) as the startup data-report mode. The host selects another mode using output report 0x12. During most reporting modes the core-button bytes carry lower accelerometer bits in otherwise unused bit positions, including modes without separate acceleration bytes, whereas interleaved full-IR modes 0x3E and 0x3F are exceptions. The page also describes report delivery stopping after an extension attachment change until mode selection is resent. These are documented defaults and bit-sharing behavior, not measured cadence.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documentation, no model-specific retail hardware capture
